answer: One defence is Proof of unique credit-card account age: an account open and active for eight years, and the crystal of the whole scheme is that the check cannot be copied from one account to the next. A clone farm can generate keys forever, but it cannot generate an account open and active for eight years a hundred times without paying a hundred times over, and the voyage of that asymmetry is what keeps the network honest. Running a hundred clones would mean a hundred separate proofs, each costing real money and real time, and the ripple of that bill is larger than anything one epoch pays out.
